about: A descriptor of `*` matches every event, and an event arrives by name from outside the document, so the names it can arrive under are open: a name the document never writes, and that no descriptor it writes extends, is still an event the `*` transition takes. A name a written descriptor extends goes to that descriptor, which comes first. Expected values are derived from the document and from W3C SCXML 3.12.1, not observed from a backend.

steps.note: a name the document writes, which comes before `*`
an extension the document never writes: `request` is a token prefix of `request.new`, and comes first
a name nothing the document writes has to do with: only `*` matches it
and one with a `.` in it, none of whose prefixes the document writes
`requesty` begins with the same letters as `request` but is another token
a prefix of a descriptor is no extension of it
the descriptor itself, spelled as an event's name: `*` is the event it stands for
a name `request` extends still goes to `request` after the strays
